update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.32 - Doomed-run notify mode + pre-finals skill-point reserve
Added ----- - Doomed-Run Action (Training Settings): the projected-rank guard can now either stop the run (the original behavior, best for unattended farming) or "Notify only" - send a one-time heads-up (log + Discord) when the run is projected below your target grade, and keep the run running. Lets an attended run warn you instead of being cut short. - Reserve Skill Points (Skills - Pre-Finals plan, 0 = off): hold back a set number of skill points on the pre-finals purchase so they carry to the career-complete purchase, where the full skill list is known. Useful for banking toward a strong gold skill instead of letting the optimizer spend everything on filler pre-finals. The reserve caps the whole pre-finals purchase; it never applies at career-complete, where leftover points are lost anyway.
